locator.text: Display 28.5, p. 28, in the statement of Lemma 4.4

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The first clause is a definition body in two independent encodings; the second is a one-line consequence that no declaration spells out. (a) In the Lemma 4.4 formalization, SeedHandbackJets.packet slot 10 is `fun η => P₀ η + f 6 η`, i.e. Π = Π_ax + C_p, with P₀ playing Π_ax: it is smooth on J = Icc (-1) 1 (`ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P₀ J`) and profile_comparison binds a single P₀ that is passed to both P.outputs and Q.outputs, which is the paper's "Fix one smooth function Π_ax" for i = 1,2. Via Profile.curves, `f 6` is P.history 4 X = ∫₀^X E²/(2x) dx = C_p. (b) In ProfileHistories the same formula is Profiles.pressure = pressure0 η + primitive (f²), where the primitive variable is f with E = √(2x)·f (line 318), so f² = E²/(2x) and primitive (f²) = C_p; this is a change of unknown, not of content. (c) Π_i(0,η) = Π_ax(η) is stated nowhere as such: it is primitive_at_axis (`primitive F (0,η) = 0`) plus unfolding `pressure`, one rewrite. In SeedHandbackJets it cannot even be written, because the radius there is confined to Icc X₀ X₁ with 0 < X₀, so X = 0 is outside the range; there the normalization is carried instead by the fact that the same P₀ is substituted for both profiles, which is the only use the paper makes of it.
